limitations: effectiveAt preserves the public declaration date; it is not an exact biological eradication date or an assertion of continuous absence since 2010.
validThrough is a project review expiry, 365 days after the current authority page date. It is not a source-declared biological guarantee.
A USDA 2013 account places final quarantine release in early 2011. This administrative chronology discrepancy is retained in the independent review and does not establish reappearance.
conflictCheckFrom conservatively includes all of 2010 because the precise biological eradication date is unknown. Any accepted later or undated presence requires review.
The whole-state declaration supports exact county membership; it does not imply prior presence, individual eradication, or county-wide sampling in all 58 counties.
No quarantine, no survey detections, or no ledger records alone creates an absence determination.

The primary whole-state declaration supplies the explicit negative claim; APHIS Arizona-only confinement is dated corroboration. Survey silence, no quarantine, non-establishment, no interceptions and missing ledger rows are insufficient alone.

All 58 pinned county projections at as-of 2026-09-08 were independently read. Each lacked an explicit tilletia-indica pair and contained no accepted later or undated presence for this taxon; the adapter retained every projection hash. Missing pairs were not interpreted as absence.
